body:
`\cmd` raw bash, `?question` ask (no execution), `@request` one command staged for review, `@@goal` multi-step loop (confirm per step, step limit), and `:context`, `:history`, `:status`.

**Done when:** each prefix routes as specified and `@@` stops at its step limit.

---
**Design review 2026-10-14** (#63)

**Split.** The `@@` agent loop moved to #76. This issue keeps `\`, `?`, `@` and `:` dispatch. `:context` is owned by #16; this issue only routes to it. Whether `\cmd` goes through the gate is decided in #64.
title: M0.6 — Input modes and meta-commands (without @@)
